A Brainfuck program that reads n and prints n! is not in this suite.
A Brainfuck program that reverses a line is not in this suite.
BASIC INPUT reads a line of digits. It has no string input.
Forth programs are one line and loops do not nest, so the variable-length song is unsupported.
A Brainfuck bottles song is not in this suite.
BASIC cannot build the verse text for a variable count in this suite.
A Brainfuck guessing program is not in this suite.
BASIC has no loop that stops when the guess matches.
A Brainfuck program that reads a count and sums the lines is not in this suite.
A Brainfuck palindrome program is not in this suite.
BASIC has no loop that stops at zero, so this suite does not reverse the digits.
A Brainfuck ROT13 program is not in this suite.
BASIC INPUT reads a line of digits. It has no string input.
